NOTICE: The U.S. Government currently occupies leased medical office space in Ukiah, CA that will be expiring. This is not a solicitation for offer, nor a request for proposals. The Government is interested in considering alternative space if economically advantageous, and that otherwise, the Government intends to pursue a sole source acquisition. In making this determination, the Government will consider, among other things, the availability of alternative space that potentially can satisfy the Government’s requirements, as well as costs likely to be incurred through relocating, such as physical move costs, replication of tenant improvements and telecommunication infrastructure, and non-productive agency downtime.

The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs Seeks Expressions of Interest to lease approximately 9,980 American National Standards Institute/Building Owners and Managers Association (ANSI/BOMA) Square Feet, not to exceed 9,980 Rentable Square Feet (RSF) of Medical Outpatient Clinic and Office space in the area of Ukiah CA. The location to include 40 parking spaces. Beneficial Occupancy estimate is October 1st, 2027. 

All interested parties should submit Expressions of Interest, Electronically, no later than 5pm. Pacific Daylight Time (PDT),  March 23rd, 2026.                Attention: Detpartment of Veterans Affairs, Loren Mollner       loren.mollner@va.gov

Respondents are advised that the Government assumes no responsibility to award a lease based upon responses to this advertisement
